description: Get optimal posting times derived from historical engagement: top hours and top days of week, plus full by-hour and by-day breakdowns. Supported on these platforms only: instagram, twitter, bluesky, threads, facebook, linkedin, pinterest, tiktok, youtube, mastodon (not telegram or google-business). Pass accountId to scope to one account, or platform to scope to a platform, or neither to merge across all analytics-enabled accounts. Returns an empty result when there isn't enough posting history yet.

accountId.description: Optional. Scope to one account (from list_accounts). Omit to merge across all analytics accounts.

platform.description: Optional. Scope to one platform (any of the analytics-supported platforms).

name: get_best_posting_times
title: Get Best Posting Times
